iPhone owners could receive up to $95 under a proposed $250 million settlement resolving claims that Apple misled customers about Siri's artificial intelligence features, according to a recent court filing. The class-action lawsuit, filed in federal court in the Northern District of California on behalf of U.S. consumers, claims that Apple deceived customers by marketing "Enhanced Siri features" that did not yet exist, leading them to buy iPhones based on false advertising. The plaintiffs are seeking a $250 million settlement payment, according to a recent court filing. If approved by a judge, it could rank among the largest settlements involving Apple. "Apple has reached a settlement to resolve claims related to the availability of two additional features," an Apple spokesperson said in an email to CBS News. "We resolved this matter to stay focused on doing what we do best, delivering the most innovative products and services to our users."
Clarkson Law Firm, a public interest law firm that filed the original lawsuit against Apple, said in a statement on Wednesday that the settlement would provide "timely relief to tens of millions of consumers nationwide."
Here's what to know about the recent settlement. Am I eligible? The settlement covers people who purchased an iPhone 16 model, iPhone 15 Pro or iPhone 15 Pro Max between June 10, 2024, and March 29, 2025. Approximately 37 million iPhone owners are eligible, according to the court filing. Customers will be notified by either email or mail if they can file a claim. An online social media campaign will also provide information about the settlement website and who is eligible, according to the court filing. How much money could I get? Eligible customers will initially receive $25 per device. Depending on how many claims are submitted and other determining factors, the final payment may increase or decrease, but it will not exceed $95 per device, according to the court filing

that a settlement website with more details will be available in "a few weeks."

records.query: Apple 在最近的 WWDC 上關於 Siri 有什麼新消息？
records.answer:
Apple 在今年的 WWDC 上宣布全新 **Siri AI**，將於今年秋季以 beta 形式在美國先行推出，具備跨應用情境理解、語音輸入與個人化功能，且部分核心模型由 Google Gemini 提供【AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0】。

- Apple 在 WWDC 發表會上正式揭露 Siri AI，並說明會在今年稍後以 beta 版上線，首波僅在美國、以英文提供【AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 新版 Siri 能從使用者的 App 中抽取上下文，讓使用者只需口說「我妹妹推薦的那個 Podcast」即可直接呈現內容，無需自行開啟其他 App 或服務【AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0】。  
- Siri AI 依賴 Apple 與 Google 簽署的協議，採用 Google 的 Gemini 系列模型（包括 Gemini Flash‑Lite、Gemini Flash、Gemini Pro 以及 Gemini Image），但 Apple 不使用 Google 向客戶部署的模型或基礎設施【AAPL_News_20260612_02.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 功能上，Siri AI 將更著重語音輸入（voice dictation）與即時問答，讓使用者可以直接以語音取得答案【AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #0】。  
- Apple Intelligence 也會在 Safari 瀏覽器、密碼管理與訊息應用中發揮作用，提升 AI 整合度【AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 同時，iOS 介面將推出視覺升級與家長監護功能，增強使用者體驗與安全性【AAPL_News_20260612_05.txt, chunk #0】。

- 針對隱私與安全，Apple 在演示中特別提到 Siri 會更個人化，同時加強隱私保護，並說明目前仍處於早期測試階段，需適度調整期待【AAPL_News_20260612_01.txt, chunk #2】。

After two years of delays, Apple's (
AAPL
) reinvented Siri, Siri AI,
appears ready for primetime
. The company unveiled the AI-powered version of its assistant at its Worldwide Developers Conference in Cupertino, Calif., on Monday, saying it will launch, albeit as a beta, later this year. The update is designed to transform Siri from a glorified kitchen timer to a
digital helper for the AI age
. Apple said Siri AI will be able to pull context from your apps, allowing you to, say, ask it the name of a podcast your sister recommended via text and have it presented to you without opening any separate apps or services. The idea is for Siri AI to recognize what you want, when you want it, and surface it, whether it's content on your device or from the web. It's more or less what Apple promised when it showed off its AI-enhanced Siri and Apple Intelligence at WWDC 2024. And in early demos, Siri AI, which rides on Apple Intelligence, appears to deliver on Apple's initial vision for its reimagined Siri. And it's thanks, at least in part, to Google (
GOOG
,
GOOGL
). Siri gets Google brains
In January, Apple and Google signed an agreement for Apple to use the search giant's Gemini models to power its improved Siri. That gave Apple the high-powered AI models it needed to move Siri AI forward, after its own models fell short,
Bloomberg's Mark Gurman previously reported
. During a question and answer session following Apple's WWDC keynote, senior vice president of software engineering Craig Federighi explained how Apple uses Google's models to give Siri AI its smarts. The software chief was sure to point out that Siri AI isn't just a rebranded version of Google's own Gemini assistant. Federighi explained how the Gemini assistant uses Google's Gemini models, including Gemini Flash-Lite, Gemini Flash, Gemini Pro, and its Gemini Image models. When it comes to grounding those models in world knowledge, he said, Gemini takes advantage of Google Search. Apple, Federighi said, uses none of those things. "We use none of the models that Google deploys to their customers, nor do we use the infrastructure and means by which they employ models to their customers," he explained.

- IREN 宣布與 NVIDIA 簽署 **34 億美元、為期五年的 AI Cloud 合約**，合約金額會在 GPU 部署時逐步解鎖，並已在合約中確認約 **7 億美元的 ARR** 與之相關【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 同時，NVIDIA 獲得 **最高 21 億美元的投資權利**，可在未來五年內以每股 70 美元的價格購買最多 3000 萬股 IREN 普通股，投資金額僅在 NVIDIA GPU 基礎設施部署後才會完全生效，完整授權需等 **60 萬顆 GPU** 部署完成【NVDA_News_20260508_02.txt, chunk #0】【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 合作的實體部署目標包括 **2026 年建置 480 MW AI Cloud 容量、150,000 顆 GPU**，並在 **2027 年擴大至 1,210 MW**（其中 730 MW 正在建設中）【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- 其中 **300 MW 的 Childress 液冷專案** 以及 **60 MW 的空冷 Blackwell GPU 部署** 均屬於與 NVIDIA 共同執行的 AI 基礎設施建設【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #2】。  
- IREN 已將 **已確保的電力提升至 5 GW**，為未來的 AI 計算基礎設施提供充足電力供應【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】。  
- 為支援 Microsoft 的 GPU 相關資本支出，IREN 透過預付款與 GPU 融資方式為 **約 95% 的資本支出提供資金**，平均利率約 **3%**，顯示 NVIDIA 合作夥伴關係亦延伸至其他大型雲端客戶【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #3】。  

以上資訊說明了 NVIDIA 與 IREN 近期在 AI Cloud 合約、股權投資、GPU 部署與電力基礎建設等多層面的合作進展。

records.query: 關於 NVIDIA 賣 AI 晶片到中國，最近有什麼消息？
records.answer:
Nvidia 最近透露，儘管中國仍限制高階 AI 晶片的銷售，但公司預期未來中國市場會逐步開放，允許出售 H200 晶片【NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #0】。

- Nvidia 執行長 Jensen Huang 在接受 Bloomberg 訪問時表示，「隨著時間推移，市場將會開放」；他指出中國政府需要決定要保護多少本地市場份額【NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #1】。  
- 目前 H200 晶片已取得對中國的授權銷售資格，但截至目前尚未看到中國科技公司實際購買的跡象，因為北京正加速自研晶片以挑戰美國主導地位【NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #0】。  
- 最高階的 Blackwell 與即將推出的 Rubin 系列仍被美國禁令禁止在中國銷售，這些產品仍無法進入中國市場【NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #1】。  
- 前美國總統特朗普在去年十二月曾與習近平達成協議，放寬對 H200 晶片的限制，然而此舉亦引發部分美國立法者擔憂可能助長中國軍事能力【NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #1】。  

總結來說，Nvidia 正在觀察中國市場的逐步開放，H200 晶片已獲授權可銷售，但實際需求仍未顯現，且更高階的 AI 晶片仍受禁令限制。

China market for Nvidia AI chips to open 'over time': Huang
AFP
Tue, May 19, 2026 at 11:02 AM GMT+8
2 min read
NVDA
-1.33%
Nvidia boss Jensen Huang expects China to eventually open its market to high-end US chips that can train and run artificial intelligence systems. But he did not discuss sales of the powerful H200 model with top officials in Beijing, the businessman told Bloomberg Television in an interview broadcast Monday. Huang travelled to the country last week with US President Donald Trump, who met Chinese President Xi Jinping. The superpowers are in a fierce race for AI supremacy, and the H200 chip had until recently been barred from sale in China by Washington over national security concerns. However, there is no sign that Chinese tech companies are buying them, as Beijing ramps up domestic chip development in a bid to challenge US dominance in the key sector. "H200s are licensed to sell to China.

[NVDA] But the Chinese government has to decide how much of their local market do they want to protect," Huang said. "My sense is that over time the market will open," added Huang, CEO of Nvidia -- the world's most valuable company, due to huge demand for its AI hardware. Trump said in December he had reached an agreement with Xi to ease the restrictions on H200 chips, a move some US lawmakers have warned could help the Chinese military. Nvidia's most top-of-the-range offerings, the Blackwell and forthcoming Rubin series, remain banned for sale in China. Xi told a delegation of US business executives on Thursday that China would "open wider" to the world.

records.query: NVIDIA 財報前，新聞關注它面臨哪些競爭與市場焦點？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 在財報公布前的新聞聚焦於它正面臨來自多家 AI 晶片競爭者的壓力，同時市場焦點落在中國業務挑戰與客戶自建晶片的趨勢上。  

- Nvidia 正在與 **Cerebras**（CBRS）競爭，後者的 AI 處理器據稱提供更快的整體效能【NVDA_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4】。  
- **AMD** 亦將於今年稍後推出競爭性的機架規模伺服器系統，直接挑戰 Nvidia 的 AI 伺服器布局【NVDA_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4】。  
- Nvidia 的主要客戶 **Amazon (AMZN)** 與 **Google (GOOG/GOOGL)** 正在向第三方客戶提供自家 AI 晶片，進一步削弱 Nvidia 的市場份額【NVDA_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4】。  
- Amazon 在最新財報中透露，其晶片業務的年度收入跑道已超過 **200 億美元（$20 billion）**，且以三位數的年增率成長，顯示客戶自建晶片的規模快速擴大【NVDA_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4】。  
- 另外，新聞亦提到 Nvidia 正面臨 **中國市場的困境**，這是其營運的另一大焦點【NVDA_News_20260519_01.txt, chunk #4】。  

以上資訊皆來自於 2026 年 5 月 18 日的相關報導，說明了 Nvidia 在即將公布 Q1 財報前，市場關注的競爭格局與關鍵業務挑戰。

   - 合約條款規定，NVIDIA 的 **21 億美元（$2.1 billion）** 投資將在 GPU 基礎設施實際部署時逐步解鎖，全部投資在部署 **600,000 個 GPU** 後完全生效【NVDA_News_20260508_01.txt, chunk #1】。

IREN Shares Jump as Nvidia Deal Sharpens Bitcoin Miner’s AI Pivot
$IREN
$NVDA
2 hours ago
By: CryptoProwl
IREN Limited (NASDAQ:
$IREN
) shares jumped in after-hours trading on Thursday after the company announced a new Nvidia (NASDAQ:
$NVDA
) partnership that gives its AI infrastructure pivot a much larger public-market signal. The stock rose 27% to $72.28 after closing at $56.85, before pulling back to $69.45 at press time, still up more than 21%. The rally followed IREN’s disclosure of a five-gigawatt strategic partnership with Nvidia tied to the deployment of AI infrastructure across its global data center pipeline. Under the agreement, IREN issued Nvidia a five-year right to purchase up to 30 million ordinary shares at $70 per share. If fully exercised, the right would represent up to $2.1 billion of potential investment, subject to conditions including regulatory limits. The partnership is expected to focus on Nvidia-aligned DSX AI factory infrastructure, with future deployments centred around IREN’s two-gigawatt Sweetwater campus in Texas. IREN also announced a separate five-year, $3.4 billion AI Cloud contract with Nvidia for air-cooled Blackwell GPUs, with deployment expected within 60 megawatts of existing data centers at Childress and a targeted ramp beginning in early 2027. The update pushes IREN further away from the pure bitcoin-mining identity it carried when it operated as Iris Energy.

records.answer:
NVIDIA 在2026年第一季的毛利率約為 75%（毛利 611.57 億美元（$61,157 million） 除以營收 816.15 億美元（$81,615 million））【NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #0】。

- **毛利率計算**：毛利 611.57 億美元（$61,157 million） ÷ 營收 816.15 億美元（$81,615 million） ≈ 0.7495，即約 74.9%（四捨五入為 75%）【NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #0】。  
- **中國市場的最新談話**：黃仁勳在接受 Bloomberg 訪問時表示，中國最終會「逐步」開放高階美國 AI 晶片的市場，並提到 H200 晶片已取得對華授權銷售，但目前尚未看到中國企業實際採購【NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #0】。他同時指出，Blackwell 與即將推出的 Rubin 系列仍被禁止在中國銷售【NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #1】。

**潛在營收影響**  
1. **市場開放的正面效應**：若中國逐步放寬對高階 AI 晶片（如 H200）的限制，NVIDIA 可在全球最大且增長最快的 AI 計算需求市場中取得新訂單，這將為未來營收提供顯著的增長動能。  
2. **短期限制因素**：目前 H200 仍未有實際採購跡象，且 Blackwell 與 Rubin 系列仍被禁售，意味著即時的營收貢獻仍受限，短期內對營收的提振可能有限。  
3. **長期機會**：隨著中國加速本土晶片研發，同時也可能提升對先進外部供應商的需求，若政策持續放寬，NVIDIA 可透過授權銷售與合作夥伴關係，捕捉中國 AI 數據中心與雲端服務的長期需求，進一步提升未來幾年的營收成長潛力。  

綜合來看，NVIDIA 目前的毛利率保持在約 75% 的高水準，顯示其高毛利的 AI 硬體產品組合仍具備強勁獲利能力；而黃仁勳對中國市場逐步開放的樂觀預期，若最終實現，將為公司未來營收提供重要的增長來源，但短期內仍需觀察實際訂單落實情況。

After two years of delays, Apple's (
AAPL
) reinvented Siri, Siri AI,
appears ready for primetime
. The company unveiled the AI-powered version of its assistant at its Worldwide Developers Conference in Cupertino, Calif., on Monday, saying it will launch, albeit as a beta, later this year. The update is designed to transform Siri from a glorified kitchen timer to a
digital helper for the AI age
. Apple said Siri AI will be able to pull context from your apps, allowing you to, say, ask it the name of a podcast your sister recommended via text and have it presented to you without opening any separate apps or services. The idea is for Siri AI to recognize what you want, when you want it, and surface it, whether it's content on your device or from the web. It's more or less what Apple promised when it showed off its AI-enhanced Siri and Apple Intelligence at WWDC 2024. And in early demos, Siri AI, which rides on Apple Intelligence, appears to deliver on Apple's initial vision for its reimagined Siri. And it's thanks, at least in part, to Google (
GOOG
,
GOOGL
). Siri gets Google brains
In January, Apple and Google signed an agreement for Apple to use the search giant's Gemini models to power its improved Siri. That gave Apple the high-powered AI models it needed to move Siri AI forward, after its own models fell short,
Bloomberg's Mark Gurman previously reported
. During a question and answer session following Apple's WWDC keynote, senior vice president of software engineering Craig Federighi explained how Apple uses Google's models to give Siri AI its smarts. The software chief was sure to point out that Siri AI isn't just a rebranded version of Google's own Gemini assistant. Federighi explained how the Gemini assistant uses Google's Gemini models, including Gemini Flash-Lite, Gemini Flash, Gemini Pro, and its Gemini Image models. When it comes to grounding those models in world knowledge, he said, Gemini takes advantage of Google Search. Apple, Federighi said, uses none of those things. "We use none of the models that Google deploys to their customers, nor do we use the infrastructure and means by which they employ models to their customers," he explained.

May 18 (Reuters) - Anthropic said on Monday it is revising its earlier position to allow users of its Mythos cybersecurity model ‌to share information about cyber threats with others who may be exposed ‌to similar vulnerabilities. Mythos, announced on April 7, is being deployed as part of Anthropic's "Project Glasswing," a controlled ​initiative under which select organizations, including major tech firms such as Amazon,
Microsoft
,
Nvidia
and
Apple
, are permitted to use the unreleased Claude Mythos Preview model for defensive cybersecurity purposes. Mythos' capabilities to code at a high level have given it a potentially ‌unprecedented ability to identify cybersecurity ⁠vulnerabilities and devise ways to exploit them, according to experts. Last week, Anthropic began telling partners that they are generally permitted to disclose ⁠their involvement in Glasswing and, at their own discretion, share findings, best practices, tools or code developed through the program. "We fully support our partners sharing findings with each ​other and ​companies outside of Glasswing to triage vulnerabilities," ​an Anthropic spokesperson said in a ‌statement. "While there was never a specific Glasswing NDA, confidentiality protections were something partners asked for at the outset and were built into agreements partners signed."
The protections were included in agreements with participating companies under which the model is provided, after partners sought assurances before sharing sensitive findings and expressed concern about being targeted by ‌attackers. "As the program has matured, we've adapted them ​to ensure key information can be shared broadly - ​including outside the program - for maximum ​defensive impact," the spokesperson added.

[MSFT] Anthropic said partners may share that ‌information with security teams at other companies, ​industry bodies, regulators and ​government agencies, open-source maintainers, the media or the public, subject to responsible-disclosure norms. The Pentagon is deploying Mythos to find and patch software vulnerabilities across ​the U.S. government even as ‌it races to complete a transition away from the AI company, the ​Defense Department's top technology official said last week. Cost of Sales

Cost of sales primarily consists of the purchase price of consumer products, inbound and outbound shipping costs, including costs related to sortation and delivery centers and where we are the transportation service provider, and digital media content costs where we record revenue gross, including video and music. The increase in cost of sales in Q1 2026, compared to the comparable prior year period, is primarily due to increased product and shipping costs resulting from increased sales, partially offset by operational efficiencies. Changes in foreign exchange rates increased cost of sales by $1.8 billion for Q1 2026. Shipping costs were $22.5 billion and $25.7 billion in Q1 2025 and Q1 2026. Shipping costs to receive products from our suppliers are included in our inventory and recognized as cost of sales upon sale of products to our customers. We expect our cost of shipping to continue to increase to the extent our customers accept and use our shipping offers at an increasing rate, we use more expensive shipping methods, and we offer additional services. We seek to mitigate costs of shipping over time in part through achieving higher sales volumes, optimizing our fulfillment network, negotiating better terms with our suppliers, and achieving better operating efficiencies. We believe that offering low prices to our customers is fundamental to our future success, and one way we offer lower prices is through shipping offers. Costs to operate our AWS segment are primarily classified as “Technology and infrastructure” as we leverage a shared infrastructure that supports both our internal technology requirements and external sales to AWS customers. Fulfillment

Fulfillment costs primarily consist of those costs incurred in operating and staffing our North America and International fulfillment centers, physical stores, and customer service centers and payment processing costs. While AWS payment processing and related transaction costs are included in “Fulfillment,” AWS costs are primarily classified as “Technology and infrastructure.” Fulfillment costs as a percentage of net sales may vary due to several factors, such as payment processing and related transaction costs, our level of productivity and accuracy, changes in volume, size, and weight of units received and fulfilled, the extent to which third-party sellers utilize Fulfillment by Amazon services, timing of fulfillment network and physical store expansion, the extent we utilize fulfillment services provided by third parties, mix of products and services sold, and our ability to affect customer service contacts per unit by implementing improvements in our operations and enhancements to our customer self-service features. Additionally, sales by our sellers have higher payment processing and related transaction costs as a percentage of net sales compared to our retail sales because payment processing costs are based on the gross purchase price of underlying transactions.

records.answer:
NVIDIA 目前的淨利率為 **0.62966**（即約 **62.97%**）【NVDA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #0】。

**競爭定位的啟示**：

1. **中國市場有望逐步開放**：黃仁勳在接受 Bloomberg 訪問時表示，中國最終會「逐步」開放高階 AI 晶片的市場，並指出 H200 已取得在華授權銷售【NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #0】。這暗示 NVIDIA 正期待未來能夠進入中國這個龐大需求的市場，提升其 AI 晶片的營收潛力。

2. **目前仍受限制**：儘管 H200 已獲授權，但最高階的 Blackwell 與即將推出的 Rubin 系列仍被禁止在中國銷售【NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #1】。因此，短期內 NVIDIA 只能依賴已獲授權的產品，且在中國的營收仍受政策壁壘限制。

3. **中國本土競爭加劇**：新聞指出中國正加速本土晶片研發，以挑戰美國在關鍵 AI 晶片領域的主導地位【NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #0】。這意味著即使市場開放，NVIDIA 仍將面臨本土供應商的激烈競爭，需要依靠其技術領先與產品性能保持優勢。

4. **高毛利與財務實力支撐**：NVIDIA 目前的毛利率高達 0.74145（約 74.15%）且淨利率 0.62966，顯示其在高價值 AI 晶片上的定價與成本控制能力強大【NVDA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #0】。這為其在未來可能開放的中國市場提供了充足的資金與研發支撐。

5. **戰略風險與機會共存**：黃仁勳提到中國政府需決定保護本土市場的程度，暗示政策走向仍具不確定性【NVDA_News_20260519_03.txt, chunk #1】。若中國放寬限制，NVIDIA 可快速擴大 AI 晶片的銷售；若限制持續或加嚴，則需依賴其他區域市場維持成長。

綜合以上，NVIDIA 目前擁有極高的淨利率與毛利率，顯示其 AI 晶片業務極具獲利能力；同時，黃仁勳對中國市場「逐步」開放的表態透露出公司正將未來的營收增長視為中國市場的重要機會，但也必須應對本土競爭與政策不確定性的雙重挑戰。

- **跨領域整合**：平台不僅服務資料中心 AI，亦延伸至 Gaming（GeForce RTX、DLSS、Ray Tracing）【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #26】、Professional Visualization、Automotive（DRIVE Hyperion、DRIVE AGX）以及雲端服務供應商，形成多元且互相增強的收入來源【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  

上述硬體、軟體與生態系統的深度耦合，使 NVIDIA 能在 AI 與高效能運算市場保持技術領先與客戶黏著度，構成其最核心的護城河。

records.query: Amazon 在 AWS 基礎設施與 AI 領域（含與 Anthropic 的合作）的投資策略是什麼？
records.answer:
Amazon 的投資策略是持續擴大 AWS 基礎設施與人工智慧（AI）相關支出，同時透過可轉換公司債與優先股大量投資 Anthropic，以加速自家 AI/ML 服務與雲端平台的競爭力。[AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #198]  

**1. 整體技術與基礎設施支出方向**  
- Amazon 明確表示，未來會「持續增加技術與基礎設施的支出」，因為需要添購伺服器、網路設備與資料中心折舊攤銷，並招聘更多員工以支援 AI 與機器學習計畫。[AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #215]  
- 2025 年與前一年比較，基礎設施成本上升主要來自「基礎設施支出增加，包括折舊與攤銷」；外匯變動亦使成本增加 3.12 億美元（$312 million）。[AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #215]  
- 2026 年第一季（Q1 2026）相較於可比前一年，同樣因「基礎設施支出增加，包括折舊與攤銷」而導致成本上升，外匯因素額外增加 3.74 億美元（$374 million）。[AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #78]  
- 2025 年第三季（Q3 2025）與全年累計（截至 2025‑09‑30）亦因「基礎設施支出增加，包括折舊與攤銷」而提升成本，外匯影響為 1.28 億美元（$128 million）（僅 Q3）[AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #72]  

**2. AWS 為核心投資領域**  
- Amazon 強調投資於 AWS 的「即時需求技術服務」——包括計算、儲存、資料庫、分析與機器學習，服務對象涵蓋各類開發者與企業。[AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #198]  
- 這些投資同時支援其他業務，如自有商品與服務的線上展示與物流，屬於跨功能系統與營運的支撐。[AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #198]  

**3. AI/ML 與合作夥伴 Anthropic 的資本投入**  
- 2025 年第二季（Q2 2025）Amazon 投入 13 億美元（$1.3 billion） 於 Anthropic 的新可轉換債，並計畫於 2025 年第四季再投資 14 億美元（$1.4 billion）。[AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #37]  
- 2025 年第三季（Q3 2025）部分可轉換債轉為非投票優先股，產生約 23 億美元（$2.3 billion） 的收益，同時在「其他收入（費用），淨額」中記錄 72 億美元（$7.2 billion） 的上調，反映 Anthropic 股價變動。[AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #37]  
- 2026 年第一季（Q1 2026）Amazon 再次投資 50 億美元（$5.0 billion） 於 Anthropic 的非投票優先股，並於同季投資 150 億美元（$15.0 billion） 於 OpenAI 的 C 系列優先股，另簽署最高 350 億美元（$35.0 billion） 的認購承諾。[AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40]  
- 2025 年底（12/31/2025）與 2026 年第一季（3/31/2026）之間，非投票優先股帳面價值從約 148 億美元（$14.8 billion） 增至 320 億美元（$32.0 billion），顯示持股規模大幅擴張。[AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #40]  

**4. 投資模式與資本化政策**  
- 大部分與衛星寬頻與自駕車相關的研發成本目前以「費用」方式列示，待服務商業化後才會資本化。[AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #198]  
- 同樣地，與衛星網路相關的發射服務押金亦先列為費用，未來若服務達到商業可行性，將轉為資本化。[AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #33]  

**5. 長期資本支出與成長預期**  
- Amazon 預期「技術與基礎設施支出將隨時間增加」，因為持續擴張地理覆蓋、提升系統跨功能性，以及支援 AI/ML 應用的需求。[AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #198]  
- 這些投資旨在「提升客戶體驗」與「提升流程效率」，同時透過規模效應降低成本，保持在雲端與 AI 市場的領先地位。[AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #198]  

綜合以上，Amazon 透過持續加碼 AWS 基礎設施、擴大 AI/ML 研發人力與資本支出，並以大量投資 Anthropic（包括可轉換債、非投票優先股）以及 OpenAI 的方式，打造以雲端與生成式 AI 為核心的長期成長平台。

records.query: Amazon 在 AWS、Prime 與電商業務上面臨哪些反壟斷或監管風險？
records.answer:
Amazon 正面臨多項與反壟斷及監管相關的風險，主要集中在其電商平台（包括實體店與履約網路）、Prime 會員服務，以及 AWS 雲端服務上【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #156】。

**1. 競爭與消費者保護相關的調查**  
- 監管機構正對 Amazon 的店舖營運、履約網路與 Prime 服務提出「可能違反競爭或消費者保護規則」的指控，並展開正式或非正式的調查【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #108】【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #156】。  
- 同樣的調查也涵蓋 AWS 的雲端服務，指稱其可能違反競爭相關規定【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #108】【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #156】。

**2. 數據隱私與資料使用的監管不確定性**  
- Amazon 正在面臨一系列關於「資料收集、使用與揭露」的法律與規範調查，這些規範仍在演變中，增加了未來合規成本與法律風險【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #108】【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #156】。

**3. 「門檻者」(gatekeeper) 身分帶來的額外監管**  
- 政策制定者將科技公司（包括 Amazon）視為線上「門檻者」，因此正透過既有法規與新法規加強對其業務的管控，這可能導致合規成本上升並限制業務運作【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #108】【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #156】。

**4. 潛在的財務與聲譽衝擊**  
- 若不利的規範、法律決策或執法行動最終成立，Amazon 可能面臨「巨額罰款、民事或刑事責任、需求下降、營運成本上升、必須改變營運方式」等實質影響，進而阻礙成長或損害聲譽【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #108】【AMZN_10K_2025.html, chunk #156】。

**5. 其他相關調查**  
- 2026 年的 10‑Q 亦提到 Amazon 在意大利面臨稅務挑戰，顯示其全球營運持續受到各國稅務與監管機構的審查【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #113】。

總結來說，Amazon 在電商、Prime 以及 AWS 三大核心業務上，都受到競爭法、消費者保護法、資料隱私法以及「門檻者」相關法規的多重調查與潛在罰則，這些監管風險可能導致合規成本上升、營運限制以及財務與聲譽上的不利影響。

records.query: Google 如何把 Gemini AI 整合進搜尋與其他產品生態系？
records.answer:
Google 透過將 Gemini 系列模型嵌入搜尋、工作平台、雲端服務與消費者產品，讓 AI 的多模態理解與進階推理功能遍佈整個生態系統。  

- 在搜尋方面，Google 已將 Gemini 3 的先進多模態與推理能力整合至 **Search**，讓 AI Overviews 能以自然語言回應使用者問題，AI Mode 也利用 Gemini 的高階推理與多模態功能讓使用者只需一次搜尋即可得到更完整的答案【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  
- Gemini 亦被內建於 **Gemini App**，以及所有 15 個半億用戶規模的產品（其中七個產品擁有 20 億用戶）中，確保從手機到桌面皆能使用同樣的 AI 能力【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。  
- 在企業與協作工具方面，Google 透過 **Gemini for Google Workspace** 把 AI 助手帶入 Gmail、Docs、Sheets 等應用，協助使用者撰寫、整理、視覺化與加速工作流程【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #135】。  
- 針對雲端客戶，Google Cloud 提供 **Gemini Enterprise**，讓團隊在安全平台上建立、分享與執行 AI 代理人，將 Gemini 的模型能力直接應用於企業工作流與自動化【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #135】。  
- 在消費者訂閱服務上，**Google One** 讓用戶可存取最先進的 Gemini 模型，將高階 AI 功能帶入個人使用情境【GOOGL_10Q_202606.html, chunk #71】。  
- 此外，Google 也在 **Pixel 系列裝置**、YouTube 以及其他平台上部署 Gemini，確保 AI 能力在硬體與內容服務上同步升級【GOOGL_10K_2025.html, chunk #134】。  

透過上述多層面的整合，Alphabet 以 Gemini 為核心，將先進的生成式 AI 與多模態推理能力廣泛應用於搜尋、工作協作、雲端服務與消費者產品，形成一個互相加強的 AI 生態系統。

records.query: Meta 在 AI 與 Reality Labs 上的長期願景與投資方向是什麼？
records.answer:
META 的長期願景是結合 AI 與 Reality Labs 的研發，打造以元宇宙為核心的下一代計算平台與沉浸式介面，並透過穿戴裝置與虛擬/擴增實境技術實現「下一代介面」​[META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #72]​。

- META 認為元宇宙是「下一個社交科技演進」​[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #175]​，因此自 2021 年起將策略重心轉向 AI、穿戴裝置與裝置研發，以支援虛擬與擴增實境的新介面​[META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #72]​。  
- 為了支援此願景，META 持續 **開發與訓練 AI 模型**，並預計未來會「持續增加這類投資」​[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #188]​。  
- 投資領域包括 **VR（Meta Quest 系列與 Horizon Store）**、**Horizon 平台**、以及 **穿戴裝置（Ray‑Ban Meta、Oakley Meta、Meta Neural Band 等）**，其中 2024 年推出的 Orion 原型與 2025 年的 Meta Ray‑Ban Display 均屬於長期 AR 產品路線​[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131]​。  
- 2025 年，Reality Labs 的投資已使 **整體營運利潤下降約 191.9 億美元（$19.19 billion）**，且 META 預期 2026 年的 Reality Labs 營運虧損將與 2025 年相似​[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #188]​。  
- 在 2026 年的預算配置上，META 計畫 **將約 70% 的 Reality Labs 營運費用投入穿戴裝置（wearables）**，其餘 **30% 用於 VR 與 Horizon 計畫**​[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #132]​。  
- META 亦指出，若無法在 AI、硬體與元宇宙相關技術上取得足夠利潤，或未能與關鍵合作夥伴建立關係，將可能削弱品牌、使用者基礎與財務表現​[META_10K_2025.html, chunk #175]​。  

總結來說，META 的長期投資方向是透過持續加碼 AI 研發、擴大穿戴裝置與 VR/Horizon 產品線，將 Reality Labs 打造成支撐元宇宙與下一代計算平台的核心，引導公司未來的成長與競爭力。

records.query: Meta 的廣告獲利模式與 Meta AI 在旗下 App 中扮演的角色是什麼？
records.answer:
Meta 主要透過在 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger 以及第三方行動應用程式上展示以曝光或使用者行動（如點擊）為基礎的廣告來創造營收，廣告主依照廣告展示次數或使用者完成的特定行動付費，且公司在廣告實際送達或使用者完成行動的合約期間內確認收入；若廣告安排不是以公司為主要方，則以淨額方式認列收入【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #311】。  

Meta AI 在旗下的 Family of Apps 中扮演跨平台智慧助理的角色，除了在 Facebook、Instagram、Messenger、WhatsApp 等應用內提供即時的學習、工作、內容創作與社交協助外，還支援內容排序、推薦引擎、廣告工具以及生成式 AI 體驗，並透過 AI 模型提升產品開發效率與廣告效能【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】；同時，Meta AI 亦被描述為「在我們的應用程式、獨立應用、AI 眼鏡與網路上皆可使用的助理」，顯示其在所有 App 中的整合與服務功能【META_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2】。  

此外，2026 年第一季的平均每則廣告價格較去年同期上升 12%，顯示廣告單價的變動亦是收入模型的一部份【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #216】。

Components of Results of Operations

Revenue

Family of Apps (FoA)

Advertising. We generate substantially all of our revenue from advertising. Our advertising revenue is generated by displaying ad products on Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, and third-party mobile applications. Marketers pay for ad products either directly or through their relationships with advertising agencies or resellers, based on the number of impressions delivered or the number of actions, such as clicks, taken by users. We recognize revenue from the display of impression-based ads in the contracted period in which the impressions are delivered. Impressions are considered delivered when an ad is displayed to a user. We recognize revenue from the delivery of action-based ads in the period in which a user takes the action the marketer contracted for. The number of ads we show is subject to methodological changes as we continue to evolve our ads business and the structure of our ads products. In particular, the ads we show may vary by product (for example, our video and Reels products are not currently monetized at the same rate as our Feed or Stories products), and from time to time we increase or decrease the number or frequency of ads we show as part of our product and monetization strategies. We calculate average price per ad as total advertising revenue divided by the number of ads delivered, representing the average price paid per ad by a marketer regardless of their desired objective such as impression or action. For advertising revenue arrangements where we are not the principal, we recognize revenue on a net basis.

Overview

records.query: Tesla 如何把自動駕駛（FSD/Autopilot）技術當作與競爭對手的核心差異化？
records.answer:
Tesla 透過把每台車都設計成可自動駕駛的底盤、使用自家開發的 AI 與專屬推論晶片、以及以 OTA（空中下載）方式持續升級 FSD（Supervised）功能，將自動駕駛技術打造為與競爭對手的核心差異化。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]  

- **全車自動駕駛設計**：Tesla 表示「每一輛交付的車輛皆為自動駕駛而設計」，這讓其在自動駕駛能力上與其他車廠形成明顯區隔。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]  
- **自家 AI 與推論晶片**：公司利用自研的視覺技術、系統與軟體，並以「自家設計的推論晶片」加速人工神經網路的訓練，提升自動駕駛的感知與決策能力。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]  
- **OTA 軟體更新**：所有車輛的控制與資訊娛樂軟體皆由 Tesla 內部開發，並透過 OTA 定期推送更新，持續改善安全與自動駕駛功能，確保技術領先且快速迭代。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]  
- **FSD（Supervised）訂閱模式**：除了一次性購買，Tesla 亦提供 FSD（Supervised）訂閱服務，讓使用者可持續取得最新的自動駕駛功能，形成軟體即服務的營收模型，進一步與傳統車廠區隔。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]  
- **Robotaxi 服務與網路優勢**：2025 年推出的 Robotaxi 服務以 Model Y 為平台，未來將擴展至專為自動駕駛打造的 Cybercab，結合 FSD（Supervised）與廣布的 Supercharger 超級充電站網路，提供一套完整的自動駕駛出行解決方案，與傳統叫車與其他新興自動駕駛平台直接競爭。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #31]、[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #51]

Powerwall and Megapack are our lithium-ion battery energy storage products. Self-Driving Development and Artificial Intelligence 

We use AI to develop real-world applications, such as autonomous driving solutions and robots. We develop almost all of this software, including most of the user interfaces, internally and update our vehicles’ software regularly through over-the-air updates, and work to actively improve our software security with every release. Our core vehicle technology competencies include powertrain engineering and manufacturing and our ability to design vehicles that utilize the unique advantages of an electric powertrain. We offer dual motor powertrain vehicles, which use two electric motors to maximize traction and performance in an all-wheel drive configuration, as well as vehicle powertrain technology featuring three electric motors for further increased performance in certain versions of Model S and Model X, Cybertruck and the Tesla Semi. Energy Storage Systems

We have also adopted a patent policy in which we irrevocably pledged that we will not initiate a lawsuit against any party for infringing our patents through activity relating to electric vehicles or related equipment for so long as such party is acting in good faith. We made this pledge in order to encourage the advancement of a common, rapidly-evolving platform for electric vehicles, thereby benefiting ourselves, other companies making electric vehicles and the world. Human Capital Resources 

Tesla’s ability to attract, develop and retain a talented workforce is a competitive advantage. As of December 31, 2025, our employee headcount worldwide was 134,785.

Overview

We are focused on bringing artificial intelligence (“AI”) into the real world, through products and services like Full Self-Driving (“FSD”) (Supervised) and Robotaxi, as well as working to develop and commercialize AI robots (“Bots”) (including Optimus). We intend to leverage our current operations, in which we design, develop, manufacture, sell and lease high-performance fully electric vehicles and energy generation and storage systems that increasingly deliver AI-related and enhanced software and services to our customers, to achieve that objective. We generally sell our products directly to customers, and continue to grow our global retail, service and charging footprint to accelerate the widespread adoption of our products. Segment Information

We operate as two reportable segments: (i) automotive and (ii) energy generation and storage. records.query: Tesla 在電動車市場面臨什麼樣的競爭態勢？
records.answer:
Tesla 在電動車市場面臨的是來自傳統汽車製造商以及新進入者的激烈競爭，這些競爭者同時在傳統車型與替代動力技術上與特斯拉直接較勁。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #50]

- 特斯拉的 Cybertruck、Model S、Model X、Model 3 與 Model Y 分別在皮卡、豪華轎車、豪華 SUV、小型至中型轎車與緊湊 SUV 市場與其他品牌競爭，這些市場本身即高度競爭。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #50]  
- 競爭產品主要包括來自已建立的汽車製造商的內燃機車型，且許多既有與新興的汽車公司已進入或宣布將進入電動及其他替代燃料車輛市場，直接與特斯拉的電動車型爭奪市場份額。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #50]  
- 這些公告與新車推出提升了電動車市場的發展，因為它們突顯了電動車相較於內燃機車的吸引力，進一步加劇了市場競爭態勢。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #50]  
- 多家主要汽車製造商已在美國、中國與歐洲等主要市場提供電動車，同時也有製造商推出混合動力與插電式混合動力車型，擴大了特斯拉在不同動力技術領域的競爭對手範圍。[TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #50]

records.query: Tesla 的能源生成與儲能業務在公司整體策略中扮演什麼角色？
records.answer:
能源生成與儲能業務是特斯拉整體策略的核心支柱之一，透過與汽車事業的技術共享、軟體平台整合以及新產品推出，協助公司實現多元化與長期盈利成長【TSLA_Fundamentals_20260612.txt, chunk #2】。

- **雙事業互補的技術基礎**：特斯拉將許多來自車輛的元件級技術應用於能源儲存產品，採用模組化電池系統設計以提升製造彈性，並利用自家的電力電子與 AI 能力，使儲能系統能與電網快速互動【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #32】。  
- **軟體平台驅動的價值提升**：能源儲存產品搭配 Powerhub（分散式能源資源管理）與 Autobidder（Megapack 交易平台）等軟體，可透過韌體更新持續優化，提升產品服務性與營收潛力【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #32】。  
- **新產品與市場佈局**：2025 年開始製造全新住宅翻新太陽能板，並於 2026 年 1 月啟動首次交付，同時持續製造結合美觀與耐久性的 Solar Roof，兩者皆與 Powerwall 整合，擴大住宅與商業客戶的能源生成與儲能解決方案【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #32】。  
- **營運規模與成長貢獻**：2025 年特斯拉部署了 46.7 GWh 的能源儲存產品，顯示能源業務已成為公司營運的重要組成部分【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #115】。  
- **與整體盈利策略的關聯**：公司在 2025 年強調以「差異化且高效管理的產品組合」追求盈利成長，能源生成與儲能業務與汽車事業一起構成此產品組合，並透過垂直整合供應鏈、AI 計算基礎建設以及全球基礎設施（含服務與充電網絡）擴張，支撐雙向需求與長期發展【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #115】。  

綜合上述，能源生成與儲能不僅是獨立的產品線，更是特斯拉利用車輛技術、軟體創新與垂直整合來推動多元化收入、提升客戶黏著度與實現長期盈利的關鍵策略之一。

records.query: Apple 自己在 10-K 中如何描述它在智慧型手機、PC、平板市場面臨的競爭壓力與市佔地位？
records.answer:
Apple 在 10‑K 中指出，它在智慧型手機、個人電腦與平板電腦市場僅佔少數市場份額，且面臨激烈的價格與產品競爭壓力【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。

- **競爭者資源與策略**：Apple 認為競爭者擁有「顯著的技術、行銷、分銷與其他資源」，以及「已建立的硬體、軟體與服務產品」與龐大客戶基礎，常透過模仿 Apple 的產品功能與整合方式來提供更具競爭力的解決方案【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。  
- **價格與毛利壓力**：市場競爭特別激烈，競爭者會「積極降價」並「降低產品毛利」，甚至以「幾乎無利潤或虧損」的方式販售產品【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。Apple 亦指出，這種激烈的價格競爭導致「毛利向下壓力」以及「價格敏感」的消費者與企業需求【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #23】。  
- **市場成長與需求**：Apple 提到它在全球智慧型手機、個人電腦、平板與可穿戴裝置市場的佔有率屬於「少數」；此外，某些市場「時有時無成長」或甚至「收縮」【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #24】。  
- **產品生命週期與技術採用**：這些市場的特徵包括「短產品生命週期」與「快速採用技術」的競爭者，迫使 Apple 必須持續推出創新產品與服務以維持競爭力【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #23】。  

綜合上述，Apple 在 10‑K 中描述其在智慧型手機、PC 與平板市場的競爭環境為：市場份額較小、競爭者資源豐厚且以激進的價格策略與產品模仿施壓，同時面臨毛利下降、需求波動與快速技術迭代的挑戰。

The Company also employs a variety of indirect distribution channels, such as third-party cellular network carriers and other resellers, for the sale of its products and certain of its services. During 2025, the Company’s net sales through its direct and indirect distribution channels accounted for 40% and 60%, respectively, of total net sales. Competition

The markets for the Company’s products and services are highly competitive and are characterized by aggressive price competition, downward pressure on gross margins, continual improvement in product performance, and price sensitivity on the part of consumers and businesses. The markets in which the Company competes are further defined by frequent introduction of new products and services, short product life cycles, evolving industry standards, and rapid adoption of technological advancements by competitors. Many of the Company’s competitors seek to compete primarily through aggressive pricing and very low cost structures, and by imitating the Company’s products and infringing on its intellectual property. agentic_sub_queries: Apple 自己在 10-K 中如何描述它在智慧型手機、PC、平板市場面臨的競爭壓力與市佔地位？

records.query: Apple 的第三方開發者生態系相對於 Android、Windows 等平台的黏著度是如何建立的？
records.answer:
Apple 透過讓開發者感受到在 iOS、macOS 等平台上能取得較高的預期收入、持續成長的使用者基數，以及與 Apple 硬體深度整合的生態系，來提升第三方開發者的黏著度，儘管相較於 Android（Google）與 Windows（Microsoft）其市場佔有率較小，仍必須讓開發者認為在 Apple 平台開發能帶來更佳的回報與品牌價值【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #110】。

- **感知利益與比較基礎**：Apple 明確指出，開發者會根據「在 Apple 平台上開發與在 Android、Windows、PlayStation、Nintendo、Xbox 等競爭平台上開發的收益與成本比較」來決定是否投入資源，若在 Apple 上的收益預期較高且成本可接受，開發者的黏著度就會提升【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #110】。  
- **市場佔有率的雙刃效應**：因為 Apple 在全球智慧手機、個人電腦、平板與穿戴裝置的市佔率屬於「少數」；這會讓部分開發者傾向於資源投入至市佔較大的 Android 或 Windows 平台，降低黏著度【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #110】。因此 Apple 必須透過其他方式（如高價值的 App 生態、付費訂閱與服務）來彌補市佔劣勢。  
- **持續提供創新與內容**：Apple 強調「持續提供具吸引力且創新的軟體應用」是維持使用者需求與開發者投入的關鍵；若第三方應用無法跟上技術變化或未能提供更佳的使用者體驗，開發者黏著度將受損【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #110】。  
- **人才與成本競爭**：Apple 亦指出，技術人才在矽谷高度競爭，若要吸引與留住能開發高品質 App 的開發者，必須提供具競爭力的薪酬與資源，這也是提升黏著度的必要條件【AAPL_10K_2025.html, chunk #110】。  

總結來說，Apple 透�過提升開發者在平台上可預期的收入與成長機會、深度整合的硬體與服務、生態系的創新內容，以及在人才與補償上的投入，來建立相對於 Android 與 Windows 的開發者黏著度；但因市佔較低，若未能持續提供上述優勢，開發者仍可能轉向競爭平台。

[MSFT 10-K period 2025] Individual consumers obtain these products primarily through retail outlets. We distribute our devices through third-party retailers. We have a network of field sales representatives and field support personnel that solicit orders from distributors and resellers and provide product training and sales support. Our Dynamics business solutions are also licensed to enterprises through a global network of channel partners providing vertical solutions and specialized services. OEMs 

We distribute our products and services through OEMs that pre-install our software on new devices and servers they sell. The largest component of the OEM business is the Windows operating system pre-installed on devices. OEMs also sell devices pre-installed with other Microsoft products and services, including applications such as Office and the capability to subscribe to Microsoft 365 Consumer. There are two broad categories of OEMs. The largest category of OEMs are direct OEMs as our relationship with them is managed through a direct agreement between Microsoft and the OEM. We have distribution agreements covering one or more of our products with virtually all the multinational OEMs, including Dell, Hewlett-Packard, Lenovo, and with many regional and local OEMs. The second broad category of OEMs are system builders consisting of lower-volume PC manufacturers, which source Microsoft software for pre-installation and local redistribution primarily through the Microsoft distributor channel rather than through a direct agreement or relationship with Microsoft. LICENSING OPTIONS 

We offer options for organizations of varying sizes that want to purchase our cloud services and on-premises software. We license these organizations under volume licensing agreements to allow the customer to acquire multiple licenses of products and services instead of having to acquire separate licenses through retail channels. These volume licensing programs have varying programmatic requirements and benefits to best meet the needs of our customers. Software Assurance (“SA”) conveys rights to new software and upgrades for perpetual licenses released over the contract period. It also provides support, tools, training, and other licensing benefits to help customers deploy and use software efficiently. SA is required to be purchased with certain volume licensing agreements and is an optional purchase with others. Volume Licensing Programs

Enterprise Agreement 

Enterprise Agreements offer large organizations a manageable volume licensing program that gives them the flexibility to buy cloud services and software licenses under one agreement. Enterprise Agreements are designed for medium or large organizations that want to license Microsoft products and services organization-wide over a three-year period. Organizations can elect to purchase perpetual licenses (covered with SA) and/or subscribe to cloud services. Microsoft Customer Agreement

Microsoft Customer Agreements are simplified purchase agreements presented, accepted, and stored through a digital experience. Microsoft Customer Agreements are non-expiring agreements that are designed to support all customers over time, whether purchasing through a partner or directly from Microsoft. Microsoft Online Subscription Agreement

Microsoft Online Subscription Agreements are designed for small and medium organizations that want to subscribe to, activate, provision, and maintain cloud services seamlessly and directly via the web. These agreements allow customers to acquire monthly or annual subscriptions for cloud-based services. Microsoft Products and Services Agreement 

Microsoft Products and Services Agreements are designed for medium and large organizations that want to license cloud services and on-premises software as needed, with no organization-wide commitment, under a single, non-expiring agreement. Organizations purchase perpetual licenses or subscribe to licenses. SA is optional for customers that purchase perpetual licenses. Open Value

Open Value agreements are a simple, cost-effective way to acquire the latest Microsoft technology. These agreements are designed for small and medium organizations that want to license cloud services and on-premises software over a three-year period. Under Open Value agreements, organizations can elect to purchase perpetual licenses or subscribe to licenses and SA is included. Select Plus 

A Select Plus agreement is designed for government and academic organizations to acquire on-premises licenses at any affiliate or department level, while realizing advantages as one organization. Organizations purchase perpetual licenses and SA is optional. Partner Programs 

The Microsoft Cloud Solution Provider Program offers customers an easy way to license the cloud services they need in combination with the value-added services offered by their systems integrator, managed services provider, or cloud reseller partner. Partners in this program can easily package their own products and services to directly provision, manage, and support their customer subscriptions. The Microsoft Services Provider License Agreement allows hosting service providers and independent software vendors who want to license eligible Microsoft software products to provide hosted applications and software services to their end customers. Partners license software over a three-year period and are billed monthly based on units licensed. The Independent Software Vendor Royalty Program enables partners to integrate Microsoft products into other applications and then license the unified business solution to their end users. We are subject to a wide range of laws, regulations, and legal requirements in the U.S.

The Company’s future performance depends in part on support from third-party software developers. The Company believes decisions by customers to purchase its hardware products depend in part on the availability of third-party software applications and services. Third-party developers may discontinue the development and maintenance of software applications and services for the Company’s products. If third-party software applications and services cease to be developed and maintained for the Company’s products, customers may choose not to buy the Company’s products, adversely impacting the Company’s business, results of operations, financial condition and stock price. The Company believes that third-party developer support depends on the perceived benefits of creating software and services for the Company’s products compared to competitors’ platforms, such as Android for smartphones and tablets, Windows for personal computers and tablets, and PlayStation, Nintendo and Xbox for gaming platforms. This analysis may be based on factors such as the market position of the Company and its products, the anticipated revenue that may be generated, expected future growth of product sales, and the costs of developing such applications and services. The Company’s minority market share in the global smartphone, personal computer, tablet and wearables markets can make developers less inclined to develop or upgrade software for the Company’s products and more inclined to devote their resources to developing and upgrading software for competitors’ products with larger market share. When developers focus their efforts on these competing platforms, the availability and quality of applications for the Company’s devices can suffer. The Company relies on the continued availability and development of compelling and innovative software applications for its products. The Company’s products and operating systems are subject to rapid technological change, and when third-party developers are unable to or choose not to keep up with this pace of change, their applications can fail to take advantage of these changes to deliver improved customer experiences, can operate incorrectly, and can result in dissatisfied customers and lower customer demand for the Company’s products. Failure to obtain or create digital content that appeals to the Company’s customers, or to make such content available on commercially reasonable terms, could have a material adverse impact on the Company’s business, results of operations and financial condition. The Company contracts with numerous third parties to offer their digital content to customers. This includes the right to sell, or offer subscriptions to, third-party content, as well as the right to incorporate specific content into the Company’s own services. The licensing or other distribution arrangements for this content can be for relatively short time periods and do not guarantee the continuation or renewal of these arrangements on commercially reasonable terms, or at all. Some third-party content providers and distributors currently or in the future may offer competing products and services, and can take actions to make it difficult or impossible for the Company to license or otherwise distribute their content. Other content owners, providers or distributors may seek to limit the Company’s access to, or increase the cost of, such content. The Company may be unable to continue to offer a wide variety of content at commercially reasonable prices with acceptable usage rules. The Company also produces its own digital content, which can be costly to produce due to intense and increasing competition for talent, content and subscribers, and may fail to appeal to the Company’s customers. The Company’s success depends largely on the talents and efforts of its team members, the continued service and availability of highly skilled employees, including key personnel, and the Company’s ability to nurture its distinctive and inclusive culture. Much of the Company’s future success depends on the talents and efforts of its team members and the continued availability and service of key personnel, including its Chief Executive Officer, executive team and other highly skilled employees. Experienced personnel in the technology industry are in high demand and competition for their talents is intense, especially in Silicon Valley, where most of the Company’s key personnel are located. Periods of intense competition for talent in particular fields can lead to increased costs as the Company seeks to offer competitive compensation to recruit and retain highly skilled employees.

records.query: Microsoft More Personal Computing 部門最新一季營收表現如何？哪些因素互相抵銷？
records.answer:
Microsoft More Personal Computing 部門在最新一季（截至2026年3月的季度）營收基本持平，僅下降約 1%（約 1.79 億美元（$179 million））【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #107】。  

- **Windows 與 Devices**：Windows OEM 營收因 OEM 合作夥伴持續備貨而成長 8%，但 Devices 營收下滑，導致 Windows 與 Devices 總營收下降 1.03 億美元（$103 million） 或 2%【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #107】。  
- **Gaming**：Gaming 營收下降 11 億美元（$1.1 billion） 或 6%，其中 Xbox 硬體營收跌幅 31%（主因為主機出貨量下降），Xbox 內容與服務營收下降 3%（受前一年強勁第一方內容表現影響）【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #111】。  
- **Search Advertising**：搜尋廣告營收上升 10 億美元（$1.0 billion） 或 10%，抵消了部分 Gaming 與 Devices 的下滑【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #111】。  

因此，雖然 Windows OEM 的增長與搜尋廣告的強勁表現提供了正向動能，但 Devices 與 Gaming 的顯著下滑相互抵銷，使得 More Personal Computing 營收最終僅呈現輕微下降，整體上可說是「相對持平」【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #111】。

records.query: Microsoft 最新一季整體營業利益成長多少？主要由哪些部門帶動？
records.answer:
Microsoft 在最新一季（截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日的三個月）整體營業利益成長了約 **22%**，即增加了約 **204 億美元**【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #104】。  

此成長主要由以下兩大部門帶動：  

* **Productivity and Business Processes**（生產力與商務流程）部門的營業利益從 **173.79 億美元** 提升至 **209.73 億美元**，增幅約 **21%**【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #104】。  
* **Intelligent Cloud**（智慧雲端）部門的營業利益從 **110.95 億美元** 增至 **137.53 億美元**，增幅約 **24%**【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #104】。  

合計而言，整體營業利益從 **320.00 億美元** 提升至 **383.98 億美元**，增幅約 **20%**（表格中亦顯示 20%）【MSFT_10Q_202603.html, chunk #104】。  

因此，最新一季的營業利益增長主要是受生產力與商務流程以及智慧雲端兩大部門的強勁表現所驅動。

records.query: Amazon AWS 部門最新一季營業利益成長的主要驅動因素是什麼？
records.answer:
Amazon AWS 部門在最新一季（2026 年第一季）營業利益的成長，主要是因為 **銷售額上升**，即客戶使用量增加，帶動營收顯著成長；同時，為支撐這波需求，公司投入了更多 **技術基礎建設支出**，雖然抵消了部分效益；此外，外匯變動對營業利益產生了 **負面影響**【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #79】。

- 營業利益由 Q1 2025 的 **115.47 億美元（$11,547 million）** 增至 Q1 2026 的 **141.61 億美元（$14,161 million）**，增幅來自「**銷售額增加**」以及「**為支援 AWS 業務成長而額外投資技術基礎建設**」的支出【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #79】。  
- 同期 AWS 銷售額 **成長 28%**，主要反映「**客戶使用量提升**」，僅因長期合約的價格調整而略有抵銷【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #75】。  
- 外匯匯率變動 **負向影響** 營業利益約 **3.39 億美元（$339 million）**【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #79】。  

綜合而言，AWS 營業利益的提升主要受益於客戶使用量的顯著增長，儘管技術基礎建設支出與外匯因素分別產生了部分抵銷與負面衝擊。

Meta 在最新的 2026 年第一季（截至 2026 年 3 月 31 日）總營收較 2025 年同季增長約 **33%**，即增加約 **139.97 億美元（$13,997 百萬）**（563.11 億美元（$56,311 百萬） vs 423.14 億美元（$42,314 百萬））【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #0】。  

主要驅動因素如下：  

1. **廣告收入大幅提升**：廣告營收較去年同期增加 **136.3 億美元（$13,630 百萬）**，成長 **33%**，主要因為  
   - 廣告曝光量（ad impressions）年增 **19%**【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #226】；  
   - 每則廣告平均價格年增 **12%**【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #226】。  
   這些提升受廣告需求上升、廣告定位與測量工具改進、以及有利的匯率影響所帶動。  

2. **其他收入（FoA）成長**：其他收入（包括 WhatsApp 付費訊息與 Meta Verified 訂閱）年增 **3.75 億美元（$375 百萬）**，成長 **74%**，亦為總營收增幅貢獻之一【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #226】。  

3. **Reality Labs（RL）營收小幅下降**：RL 營收下降 **0.1 億美元（$10 百萬）**（-2%），對總營收的正向貢獻有限【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #226】。  

綜合來看，廣告收入的強勁成長—受曝光量與單價雙雙上揚以及線上商務垂直領域的推動—是本季營收增長的核心動力，其他收入的顯著提升亦提供了次要貢獻。

[META 10-Q period 202603] Advertising

Advertising revenue in the three months ended March 31, 2026 increased $13.63 billion, or 33%, compared to the same period in 2025, due to increases in ad impressions delivered and average price per ad. During the three months ended March 31, 2026, ad impressions delivered increased by 19%, year-over-year, as compared with an increase of 5% in the same period in 2025. Ad impressions delivered during the three months ended March 31, 2026 grew in all regions, especially in Asia-Pacific, which was driven by increases in users and their engagement as well as the frequency of ads shown on our products. During the three months ended March 31, 2026, the average price per ad increased by 12%, year-over-year, as compared with an increase of 10% in the same period in 2025. The increase in average price per ad in the three months ended March 31, 2026 was driven by an increase in advertising demand, which we believe is mostly due to ongoing improvements to our ad performance from our ad targeting and measurement tools, and a favorable foreign currency exchange impact. This increase was partially offset by a higher number of ad impressions delivered, especially in geographies and in products, such as Reels, that monetize at lower rates. Other factors are discussed in the section entitled "—Executive Overview of First Quarter Results." In addition, the online commerce vertical was the largest contributor to the increase in advertising revenue in the three months ended March 31, 2026 compared to the same period in 2025. We anticipate that future advertising revenue will be driven by a combination of price and ad impressions delivered. Other revenue

FoA other revenue in the three months ended March 31, 2026 increased $375 million, or 74%, compared to the same period in 2025. The increase was mostly driven by paid messaging from WhatsApp and Meta Verified subscriptions. Reality Labs

RL revenue in the three months ended March 31, 2026 decreased $10 million, or 2%, compared to the same period in 2025. The decrease was driven by lower Meta Quest sales, offset by an increase in sales of AI glasses. Foreign Exchange Impact on Revenue

Changes in foreign exchange rates had a favorable impact on our revenue in the three months ended March 31, 2026 compared to the same period in 2025. To calculate revenue on a constant currency basis, we translated revenue using the prior year's monthly exchange rates for our settlement or billing currencies other than the U.S.

[META 10-Q period 202603] Many of our RL investments are directed toward long-term, cutting-edge research and development for products that may only be fully realized in the next decade. During the three months ended March 31, 2026, our RL segment reduced our overall operating profit by approximately $4.03 billion, and we expect our full-year 2026 RL operating losses to remain similar to 2025. 34


Trends in Our Revenue by User Geography 

We calculate our revenue by user geography based on our estimate of the geography in which ad impressions are delivered, virtual and digital goods are purchased, or consumer hardware products are shipped. The geography of our users affects our revenue and financial results. Our revenue in regions such as United States & Canada and Europe is relatively higher primarily due to the size and maturity of those online and mobile advertising markets, and ad impression growth is primarily in geographies that monetize at lower rates, such as Asia-Pacific. In the first quarter of 2026, revenue increased by 29% in United States & Canada, 39% in Europe, 29% in Asia-Pacific, and 40% in Rest of World, in each case relative to the same period in 2025. -

records.query: NVIDIA 這一季在中國市場的資料中心晶片出貨狀況如何？跟去年同期相比有何變化？
records.answer:
NVIDIA 在 2027 財年第一季幾乎沒有向中國市場出貨資料中心晶片，與去年同期相比，來自中國的營收從 96.59 億美元（$9,659 百萬）跌至 45.5 億美元（$4,550 百萬），下降約 53%【NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #36】；同時公司指出，儘管仍能向中國出貨非受管制的遊戲與工作站 GPU，但已被實質排除在中國資料中心計算市場之外，無法在該領域競爭【NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #75】。  

- **營收變化**：2027 財年 Q1（截至 2026 年 4 月 26 日）中國（含香港）營收為 45.5 億美元（$4,550 百萬）；2026 財年 Q1（截至 2025 年 4 月 27 日）為 96.59 億美元（$9,659 百萬）【NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #36】。  
- **出貨情況**：公司明確說明，當季只能出貨「非受管制的遊戲與工作站 GPU」給中國，資料中心晶片的出貨已被「實質排除」【NVDA_10Q_202604.html, chunk #75】。  

因此，從營收與官方說法兩方面看，NVIDIA 在本季的中國資料中心晶片出貨幾乎為零，且相關營收較去年同期大幅下降約五成。

[NVDA 10-Q period 202604] In August 2022, the USG announced export restrictions and export licensing requirements targeting China’s semiconductor and supercomputing industries. These restrictions impacted exports of certain chips, as well as software, hardware, equipment and technology used to develop, produce and manufacture certain chips to China (including Hong Kong and Macau) and Russia, and specifically impact our A100 and H100 integrated circuits, DGX or any other systems or boards which incorporate A100 or H100 integrated circuits. In July 2023, the USG also informed us of an additional licensing requirement for a subset of A100 and H100 products destined to certain customers and other regions, including some countries in the Middle East. In October 2023, the USG announced new and updated licensing requirements for exports to China and Country Groups D:1, D:4, and D:5 (including but not limited to, Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, and Vietnam, but excluding Israel) of our products exceeding certain performance thresholds, including, but not limited to, the A100, A800, H100, H800, L4, L40, L40S RTX 4090, GB200 NVL72, and B200. The licensing requirements also apply to the export of products exceeding certain performance thresholds to a party headquartered in, or with an ultimate parent headquartered in, Country Group D5, including China. In April 2025, the USG informed us that it requires a license for export to China (including Hong Kong and Macau) and D:5 countries, or to companies headquartered or with an ultimate parent therein, of our H20 integrated circuits and any other circuits achieving the H20’s memory bandwidth, interconnect bandwidth, or combination thereof. As a result of these requirements, we incurred a $4.5 billion charge in the first quarter of fiscal year 2026 associated with H20 for excess inventory and purchase obligations, as the demand for H20 products diminished. Beginning in August 2025, the USG granted licenses that would allow us to ship certain H20 products to certain China-based customers. USG officials expressed an expectation that the USG will receive 15% or more of the revenue generated from licensed sales of our products, but the USG did not publish a regulation codifying such requirement. Beginning in February 2026, the USG granted licenses that would allow us to ship small amounts of H200 products to specific China-based customers. To date, we have not generated any revenue under the H200 licensing program, and do not yet know whether any imports will be allowed into China. The license requires that the H200s go through an inspection process in the United States prior to any shipment to the customer. As a result, any H200 shipped under the new licensing program will be subject to a 25% tariff upon importation into the United States. In the event that we are able to sell licensed products into the China market, we may not be able to pass along all or any of the tariff to our customers, and may be subject to litigation, increased costs, and a harmed competitive position. The export controls applicable to China are complex and address a variety of parameters, including the total processing performance of a chip, the “performance density” of a chip, the interconnect bandwidth of a chip, and the memory bandwidth of a chip. Under the current rules and geopolitical landscape, we are unable to create and deliver a competitive product for China’s data center market that receives approval from both the USG and the Chinese government. As of the end of the first quarter of fiscal year 2027, while we were able to ship uncontrolled products to China, such as gaming and workstation GPUs, we were effectively foreclosed from competing in China's data center computing/compute market, and our effective foreclosure from the China market helped our competitors build larger developer and customer ecosystems to challenge us worldwide. Unless we are able to return with a data center system that meets the approval of both the USG and the Chinese government, our lost opportunity and the benefit to our competitors will have a material and adverse impact on our business, operating results, and financial condition.

The plaintiffs in the putative securities class action lawsuit, captioned 4:18-cv-07669-HSG, initially filed on December 21, 2018 in the United States District Court for the Northern District of California, and titled In Re NVIDIA Corporation Securities Litigation, filed an amended complaint on May 13, 2020. The amended complaint asserted that NVIDIA and certain NVIDIA executives violated Section 10(b) of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, or the Exchange Act, and SEC Rule 10b-5, by making materially false or misleading statements related to channel inventory and the impact of cryptocurrency mining on GPU demand between May 10, 2017 and November 14, 2018. Plaintiffs also alleged that the NVIDIA executives who they named as defendants violated Section 20(a) of the Exchange Act. Plaintiffs sought class certification, an award of unspecified compensatory damages, an award of reasonable costs and expenses, including attorneys’ fees and expert fees, and further relief as the Court may deem just and proper. On March 2, 2021, the district court granted NVIDIA’s motion to dismiss the complaint without leave to amend, entered judgment in favor of NVIDIA and closed the case. On March 30, 2021, plaintiffs filed an appeal from judgment in the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit, case number 21-15604. On August 25, 2023, a majority of a three-judge Ninth Circuit panel affirmed in part and reversed in part the district court’s dismissal of the case, with a third judge dissenting on the basis that the district court did not err in dismissing the case. NVIDIA filed a petition for a writ of certiorari on March 4, 2024. On June 17, 2024, the Supreme Court of the United States granted NVIDIA’s petition for a writ of certiorari. After briefing and argument, the Supreme Court dismissed NVIDIA’s writ of certiorari as improvidently granted on December 11, 2024, and issued judgment on January 13, 2025. On February 20, 2025, the Ninth Circuit’s judgment, entered August 25, 2023 and corrected August 28, 2023, took effect, and the case was remanded to the district court for further proceedings. On March 25, 2026, the district court granted plaintiffs’ motion for class certification and certified a class of investors consisting of all persons or entities who purchased or otherwise acquired NVIDIA common stock between August 10, 2017, and November 15, 2018, inclusive, excluding certain persons and entities, such as NVIDIA’s officers and directors, and members of their immediate families, among others. records.query: 為什麼大家做 AI 都要靠 NVIDIA 的技術，別家學不來？
records.answer:
因為 NVIDIA 同時提供最強大的 GPU 硬體、完整的軟體堆疊與龐大的開發者生態系，使得 AI 工作負載在效能、成本與易用性上遠超其他競爭者。  

1. **全端加速運算平台**：NVIDIA 交付從 GPU、CPU、DPU、互連到系統與軟體的完整端到端平台，讓訓練與推論都能在同一套基礎設施上完成，且持續在 GPU 架構加入 AI 專屬功能以鞏固領先地位【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  

2. **獨特的軟體生態**：CUDA、CUDA‑X、各類加速函式庫、API、SDK 以及領先的 AI 模型與資料集構成了「深厚且廣泛」的軟體堆疊，這些工具讓開發者能直接在 NVIDIA GPU 上部署深度學習演算法，且超過 0.075 億（7.5 百萬）開發者已在使用 CUDA 等工具【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  

3. **AI 企業套件與模型平台**：NVIDIA AI Enterprise 提供完整的企業級 AI 軟體套件，內含提升 token 吞吐量的 NIM、全流程模型管理的 NeMo，以及可直接部署的 AI Blueprint，讓企業能快速建置生成式與代理式 AI 應用【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #28】。  

4. **資料中心規模與效能領先**：Blackwell 架構結合 36 顆 Grace CPU 與 72 顆 Blackwell GPU，支援「即時兆參數」的推論與訓練；Blackwell Ultra 進一步提升 token 吞吐量與降低每 token 成本；Rubin 平台則宣稱相較於 Blackwell 可達 10 倍的成本下降【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #21】【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #25】。  

5. **巨量互聯 GPU**：NVIDIA 的資料中心設計允許「數十萬顆 GPU」互相連接，形成單一巨型電腦，以滿足大規模 AI 工作負載的運算需求【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】（原文為「Hundreds of thousands of GPUs」）。  

6. **市場佔有與生態合作**：NVIDIA 的平台被所有主要雲服務供應商（CSP）、AI 模型製造商與企業廣泛採用，並且在 TOP500 超級電腦中佔超過 78% 的比例，10 大 Green500 系統中有 9 台使用 NVIDIA 技術【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #22】。  

7. **產業合作與生態系統**：NVIDIA 與 OEM、ODM、系統整合商、汽車、醫療、金融、製造、零售等多領域合作夥伴共同推動 AI 採用，並透過 Inception 計畫扶持上萬家新創公司，形成難以被其他公司快速複製的生態網路【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #25】。  

8. **研發投入與創新基礎**：自公司成立以來已投入超過 **767 億美元（$76.7 billion）** 於研發，持續產出 GPU、CUDA、Tensor Core、Grace CPU 等關鍵技術，為 AI 計算提供硬體與軟體的雙重領先優勢【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #20】。  

綜合以上硬體規模、軟體堆疊、開發者社群、企業級套件與廣泛的產業合作，形成了 NVIDIA 在 AI 領域的「平台護城河」，使得其他公司難以在短期內復製同等的完整生態與效能。

records.query: 微軟是怎麼把 AI 塞進 Office 那些軟體裡的？
records.answer:
微軟是透過在 **Microsoft 365 Commercial** 內加入 AI‑驅動的 **Microsoft 365 Copilot**，並利用 Azure 的 AI 服務，將人工智慧功能嵌入 Office、Windows 以及相關的協作與分析工具中【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52】。

- **Microsoft 365 Commercial 作為 AI‑powered 平台**：此平台把 Office、Windows、Microsoft 365 Copilot 以及 Enterprise Mobility + Security 等服務整合在一起，讓 AI 工具、功能與代理情境（agentic scenarios）能在通訊、協作、分析、資安與合規等多個領域提供增值【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52】。  
- **Microsoft 365 Copilot 的角色**：Copilot 被列為 Microsoft 365 Commercial 的核心組件，直接嵌入於 Office 相關產品（如 Teams、Exchange、SharePoint、Power BI 等），提供 AI 助手功能，協助使用者提升生產力【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #52】。  
- **Azure 提供 AI‑driven 產品**：Microsoft Cloud（含 Azure）提供「AI‑driven 產品」以支援安全、合規、身分管理與資料隱私等需求，這些 AI 基礎設施與服務為 Microsoft 365 中的 AI 功能（包括 Copilot）提供底層計算與模型支援【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #49】。  
- **策略層面的說明**：公司將「重新發明生產力與商務流程」列為研發重點，透過 AI 與生成式 AI（如 Copilot）在 Microsoft 365 內創造新工具與情境，進一步驅動產品與服務的 AI 化【MSFT_10K_2025.html, chunk #49】。  

因此，微軟的 AI 嵌入方式主要是把 AI 功能（Copilot）作為 Microsoft 365 Commercial 生態系的一部份，並依賴 Azure 的 AI 基礎設施來提供計算與模型支援，從而在 Office、Windows 以及相關協作與分析服務中實現 AI 增強。

records.query: 亞馬遜最近在 AI 這塊砸錢做了什麼？跟哪家 AI 公司搭上線？
records.answer:
亞馬遜最近在 AI 領域大幅砸錢，先以可轉換債券投資 Anthropic，之後在 2026 年第一季再投入 OpenAI 的股份。  

- 2025 年第二季，亞馬遜投入 **13 億美元（$1.3 billion）** 購買 Anthropic 的可轉換債券；同年第四季將再投入 **14 億美元（$1.4 billion）** 於另一筆可轉換債券【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #37】。  
- 2025 年第三季，部分債券轉換為非投票優先股，因轉換產生約 **23 億美元（$2.3 billion）** 的其他收入，且截至 2025 年 9 月 30 日，非投票優先股的帳面價值約為 **148 億美元（$14.8 billion）**【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #37】。  
- 同日，亞馬遜在私募公司（主要是 Anthropic）的股權投資帳面價值從 2024 年底的 **9.89 億美元（$989 million）** 增至 **160 億美元（$16.0 billion）**，此金額屬於 Level 3 公允價值的非投票優先股【AMZN_10Q_202509.html, chunk #37】。  
- 2026 年第一季，亞馬遜又投入 **150 億美元（$15.0 billion）** 購買 OpenAI 的 Series C 優先股，並簽署承諾函，未來有條件再購買額外 **350 億美元（$35.0 billion）** 的 Series C 優先股【AMZN_10Q_202603.html, chunk #68】。  

因此，亞馬遜近期的 AI 投資主要與 **Anthropic**（透過可轉換債券與非投票優先股）以及 **OpenAI**（透過 Series C 優先股）兩家 AI 公司建立資本關係。

Meta 正在把 VR 眼鏡與 AI 結合，朝向打造以沉浸式、AR/VR 為核心的元宇宙平台與個人化超智慧助理的方向發展【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #128】。

- **沉浸式硬體與內容**：Meta 透過 Reality Labs 推出 Meta Quest 系列 VR 裝置，並在 Meta Horizon Store 提供軟體與內容，讓使用者在遊戲、健身、娛樂等情境中克服實體距離【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131】。為提升 VR 的接受度，Meta 加入「passthrough」功能，使使用者在虛擬環境中仍能感知現實世界【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131】。

- **AI 眼鏡與可穿戴**：Meta 的 AI 眼鏡包括 Ray‑Ban Meta、Oakley Meta，內建 Meta AI 對話助理，提供免手操作與語音互動【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131】。2024 年推出的 Orion 原型是「真正」的 AR 眼鏡，具備業界領先的視野與舒適佩戴形式，顯示 Meta 正在向全方位增強實境發展【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131】。2025 年又推出 Meta Ray‑Ban Display，結合 AI 眼鏡與鏡片內建顯示器，並搭配使用肌電訊號控制的 Meta Neural Band 手環，進一步深化 AI 與硬體的整合【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #131】。

- **長期策略與願景**：Meta 把「元宇宙」描述為超越二維螢幕的沉浸式互聯網，視其為下一代社交技術的演進，並將 AI、可穿戴與裝置的創新視為建構新介面的關鍵【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #175】。公司承認這是一項「複雜、持續演變且長期」的計畫，需大量基礎建設、隱私安全與跨公司合作【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #175】。

- **風險與挑戰**：Meta 亦指出其在消費者硬體、VR/AR 技術的經驗相對有限，可能讓其他公司在市場上更具競爭力；若無法成功研發或與元宇宙關鍵參與者建立關係，或產品與第三方平台的相容性不足，皆可能影響業務與財務表現【META_10K_2025.html, chunk #175】【META_10Q_202603.html, chunk #72】。

綜合上述，Meta 的發展方向是將 VR/AR 硬體與 AI 助理深度結合，打造以沉浸式體驗與個人化超智慧為核心的元宇宙生態系，同時持續投入大量資源於硬體研發與 AI 模型，並面對相關技術與市場接受度的不確定性。

[META 10-K period 2025] Item 1.Business 

Overview

Our mission is to build the future of human connection and the technology that makes it possible. Our products enable people to connect and share through mobile devices, personal computers, virtual reality (VR) headsets, and AI glasses. We are innovating in artificial intelligence (AI) technologies to build transformative experiences and capabilities across our Family of Apps and new platforms, and to advance our vision to deliver personal superintelligence for everyone. We build technology that helps people connect and share, find and build communities, and grow businesses. We also help people discover and learn about what is going on in the world around them, enable people to share their experiences, ideas, photos, videos, and other content with audiences ranging from their closest family members and friends to the public at large, and stay connected everywhere by accessing our products. Meta is moving our offerings beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next computing platform. Our vision does not center on any single product, but rather an entire ecosystem of experiences, devices, and new technologies powered by AI. While the metaverse is in the very early stages of its development, we believe it will become the next computing platform and the future of social interaction. Across our work, we are innovating to build new experiences that help make our platform more social, useful, and immersive. Our AI investments support initiatives across our products and services, helping power the systems that rank content in our apps, our discovery engine that recommends relevant content, the tools advertisers use to reach customers, the development of new generative AI experiences, and the tools that make our product development more efficient and productive. We are also working to develop the next generation of AI models and advance our vision to build superintelligence, which we define as AI that surpasses human intelligence. Although it is inherently difficult to predict when superintelligence may be achieved, we are investing now because we believe this has the potential to begin a new era of individual empowerment, where people can direct superintelligence towards what they value in their own lives. Family of Apps Products

•Facebook. Facebook helps give people the power to build community and bring the world closer together. It's a place for people to share life's moments and discuss what's happening, nurture and build relationships, discover and connect to people with shared interests, and create economic opportunity. They can do this through Feed, Reels, Stories, Groups, Marketplace, and more. •Instagram. Instagram brings people closer to the people and things they love. Instagram Feed, Stories, Reels, Live, and messaging are places where people and creators can connect and express themselves through photos, video, and private messaging, and discover and shop from their favorite businesses. •Messenger. Messenger is a simple yet powerful messaging application for people to connect with friends, family, communities, and businesses across platforms and devices through text, audio, and video calls. •Meta AI. Meta AI is an assistant that's available across our apps, as a stand-alone app, on our AI glasses, and on the web. It's designed to help people learn, get things done, create content, and connect with others to make the most of every moment.

[META 10-K period 2025] We may not be successful in our Reality Labs strategy and investments, which could adversely affect our business, reputation, or financial results. We believe the metaverse, an embodied internet where people have immersive experiences beyond two-dimensional screens, is the next evolution in social technology. In 2021, we announced a shift in our business and product strategy to focus on helping to bring the metaverse to life, and we are directing our efforts toward innovations in AI, wearables, and devices to help build next-generation interfaces. We expect this will be a complex, evolving, and long-term initiative that will involve the development of new and emerging technologies, continued investment in infrastructure as well as privacy, safety, and security efforts, and collaboration with other companies, developers, partners, and other participants. However, the metaverse may not develop in accordance with our expectations, and market acceptance of features, products, or services we build is uncertain. We regularly evaluate our product roadmaps and make significant changes as our understanding of the technological challenges and market landscape and our product ideas and designs evolve. In addition, we have relatively limited experience with consumer hardware products and virtual and augmented reality technology, which may enable other companies to compete more effectively than us. We may be unsuccessful in our research and product development efforts, including if we are unable to develop relationships with key participants in the metaverse or develop products that operate effectively with metaverse technologies, products, systems, networks, or standards. For example, some of our consumer hardware products depend on the ability to operate with third-party mobile platforms and these platforms do not necessarily provide our products with the same levels of interoperability that they provide to their own competing products. In addition, our Reality Labs efforts may also divert resources and management attention from other areas of our business. We expect to continue to make significant investments in virtual and augmented reality and other technologies to support these efforts, and our ability to support these efforts is dependent on generating sufficient profits from other areas of our business. In addition, as our Reality Labs efforts evolve, we may be subject to a variety of existing or new laws and regulations in the United States and international jurisdictions, including in the areas of privacy, safety, AI, competition, content regulation, medical devices, tariffs, export controls, consumer protection, and e-commerce, which may delay or impede the development of our products and services, increase our operating costs, require significant management time and attention, or otherwise harm our business. 20


As a result of these or other factors, our Reality Labs strategy and investments may not be successful in the foreseeable future, or at all, which could adversely affect our business, reputation, or financial results. If we are not able to maintain and enhance our brands, our ability to maintain or expand our base of users, marketers, and developers may be impaired, and our business and financial results may be harmed.

[META 10-K period 2025] In the near term, we are continuing to develop products and experiences that help people feel connected, anytime, anywhere. Our current product offerings in VR include our Meta Quest devices, as well as software and content available through the Meta Horizon Store, which enable a range of social experiences that allow people to defy physical distance while engaging in gaming, fitness, entertainment, and more. To drive greater adoption and acceptance of VR we have introduced passthrough capabilities, which allow users to experience the immersion and presence of VR while still being grounded in the physical world, through our Meta Quest devices. Our wearables efforts include our AI glasses and long-term AR initiatives. Our current AI glasses include the Ray-Ban Meta and Oakley Meta glasses, which feature Meta AI, our advanced conversational assistant, as well as other features such as hands-free interaction. As we continue our long-term efforts to bring AR glasses to market, in 2024 we also unveiled our Orion prototype, a pair of true AR glasses that overlay content on top of the physical world. It does this with an industry-leading field of view and in glasses form factor for comfortable wear. In 2025, we introduced Meta Ray-Ban Display, which combines our AI glasses with an integrated display built into the lens. It comes with the Meta Neural Band, which is a wrist-worn wearable device that uses electromyography to let people control their AI glasses using neuromuscular signals. records.query: 特斯拉的自動駕駛跟別家車廠比，厲害在哪裡？
records.answer:
特斯拉的自動駕駛技術（Autopilot 與 Full Self‑Driving Capability）因其在市場上的能見度與爭議而受到關注，但在提供的資料中並未列出與其他車廠在技術或效能上的直接比較，因而無法明確說明「哪裡比較厲害」【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #227】。

- **特斯拉的現況**：公司面臨多起針對 Autopilot 與 FSD 功能的集體訴訟，原告指稱這些系統存在缺陷與誤導性描述，並要求停止使用相關術語、停止銷售與啟用 FSD、以及提供消費者通知。相關訴訟自 2022 年起陸續提出，法院在 2023‑2025 年間多次作出裁決，最終在 2025 年 12 月 2 日第九巡迴法院維持原審駁回訴訟的判決【TSLA_10K_2025.html, chunk #227】。這顯示特斯拉的自動駕駛技術在法律層面仍受到高度審視。

- **其他公司的做法（以 NVIDIA 為例）**：NVIDIA 在其 2026 年 10‑K 中說明，為自動駕駛（AV）與電動車（EV）市場提供從感知、定位、規劃到推理的完整 AI 硬體與軟體解決方案，採用多個神經網路而非傳統手寫程式，並透過「DRIVE」品牌與車廠、移動服務供應商、機器人計程車、Tier‑1 供應商等合作推廣【NVDA_10K_2026.html, chunk #29】。此方案同時提供訓練神經網路所需的 GPU 硬體，以及在車內部署前的模擬與 OTA 更新支援，強調端到端的安全與效能。

**結論**：根據目前的參考資料，特斯拉的自動駕駛技術主要以其 Autopilot/FSD 功能為核心，且正面臨多項法律挑戰；而 NVIDIA 則提供一套完整的 AI 硬體與軟體平台，供車廠整合自動駕駛功能。資料未提供特斯拉相較於其他車廠在技術優勢或性能表現上的具體比較，故無法直接回答「哪裡比較厲害」的部分。若需要更詳細的技術對比，需參考其他未列於本資料的資訊。
